blocks.text: Graph aisa data structure hai jo vertices (ya nodes) ke set (group) aur unhein jorne wali edges se banta hai. Graphs connections (rabton) ke network dikhane ke liye istemal hote hain, jahan har connection do vertices ke beech ek rishta hai. Vertices kuch bhi ho sakte hain, jaise shehar, log ya koi khayal (concept), aur edges un ke beech rishte ya raaste hain.

Sochiye aap Pakistan ke saare shehron aur unhein jorne wali sarkon ka map (naqsha) bana rahe hain. Har shehar ek vertex hai aur do shehron ke beech har sarak ek edge. Tree ke ulat, graph ki koi ek “root” nahi hoti aur na hi hierarchy (oopar-neeche ke darje). Graph mein koi bhi do vertices jur sakte hain, is liye rishton ka ek complex (pecheeda) jaal (web) ban jata hai.

Misal: social network mein har shakhs bohat se logon se jura ho sakta hai, aur yeh graph banta hai. Yahan koi ek starting point (shuru ki jagah) nahi, aur logon (vertices) ke kai connections (edges) ho sakte hain jo tree ki tarah parent-child wale pakke rishte par nahi chalte.
Tree se farq: graphs aur trees dono cheezon ke rishte dikhate hain, magar tree asal mein graph ki ek khaas qisam hai, jis ke kuch zaroori farq hain:

items: Tree hierarchical (darjon wala) hota hai: us ki ek hi root node hoti hai jis se baqi saare nodes shaakhon ki tarah nikalte hain. Graph mein hierarchy ya root zaroori nahi.
Tree mein kinhi bhi do nodes ke beech sirf ek raasta hota hai, is liye cycle (chakkar) nahi banta. Graph mein do nodes ke beech kai raaste ho sakte hain aur cycles ki ijazat hai.

Trees aksar structured (tarteeb wala) data dikhate hain, jaise family tree ya organisational chart. Graphs zyada flexible (lachakdar) hain aur networks, web links ya transport systems jaise har tarah ke connections dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Tree aur graph mein do farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Tree ki ek root aur hierarchy hoti hai, graph mein zaroori nahi. Tree mein do nodes ke beech bilkul ek raasta aur koi cycle nahi; graph mein kai raaste aur cycles ho sakte hain.

items: Graph: edges se jure vertices; koi ek root nahi; cycles ho sakte hain; tree graph ki khaas qisam hai.
